description: One pundit's election record: their graded election record across cycles (accuracy, MissedTakes Score, sample size) and their calls in one cycle (the one the site's election pages open on unless you pass cycle), newest first. Look up by slug, or by part of their name.

cycle.description: The cycle whose calls to list. Omit for the one the site's election pages open on.

name.description: Part of the pundit's name, when the slug is unknown.

name: election_pundit
title: A pundit's election record
